subject: Manager onboarding: handoff + performance coaching plan for Priya
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <cjensen@people-practice.co>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Manager onboarding & coaching plan for Priya

Hi team,

Nice to meet you over email — I'm Claire from People Practice. Per our intake call last week, attached is a proposed manager onboarding package and a short coaching module aimed at difficult conversation readiness and mid-year performance calibration.

Attachments: manager_onboarding_checklist.pdf (1 page), performance-coaching-slides.pptx (10 slides)

High level ask: can we lock a 60-minute calibration session (team leads + HR) and a 30-minute 1:1 skills session for Priya within the first two weeks of her start? Suggested windows below:
- Mon Jul 20, 10:00-11:00 PT
- Tue Jul 21, 14:00-15:00 PT
- Wed Jul 22, 09:00-10:00 PT

Goals for calibration:
- Align on performance expectations and the upcoming review cadence
- Share hard examples and scoring rubric used by the org
- Agree escalation path for sensitive conversations

Please reply with availability and any materials you'd like folded into the session. Also: if there's a handoff notes doc from the previous manager, send that along — it will help tailor the coaching scenarios.

Thanks,
Claire Jensen
Senior Consultant, People Practice
(onboarding@people-practice.co)

--
Note: I will send calendar invites once we confirm availability.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <cjensen@people-practice.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager onboarding & coaching plan for Priya

Claire — thanks, this looks good and actionable.

Quick answers:
- We're fine with a 60-minute calibration + 30-minute 1:1. Prefer Mon Jul 20 10:00 PT for the calibration.
- Priya's first day is Jul 19; she prefers at least one async doc ahead of live coaching.
- Laura, can you share the handoff notes and any recent performance snapshots you use for Priya's group?
- Marcus, please confirm if you or someone from the leadership bench will attend the calibration — we want an exec voice for the escalation/SLAs.

I'll coordinate invites and confirm materials to fold into the exercises. If everyone's OK I'll ask Claire to send the DocuSign link for the manager acknowledgement forms and the calendar invites.

Stephanie Nguyen
People Ops (Manager Enablement)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Claire Jensen <cjensen@people-practice.co>

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager onboarding & coaching plan for Priya

On Sun, Jul 12, 2026 at 09:15 AM Claire Jensen <cjensen@people-practice.co> wrote:
> Hi team,
>
> Nice to meet you over email — I'm Claire from People Practice. Per our intake call last week...

Adding handoff notes (see attachment). Short bullets to get you started:
- Priya has been leading a product analytics team of 6; strengths in cross-team stakeholder mgmt, weaker on direct performance conversations when engineers miss timelines.
- Last review cycle: two EOCs (escalation-of-concern) addressed — both resolved, one in Q1 (missed delivery) and one in Q2 (team communication).
- Suggest using the "two-track" approach in slides: fact-based feedback + growth plan with measurable checkpoints (I used these successfully last year).

Attachment: handoff-notes-priya.docx (3 pages)

I can join the calibration for 20–30 minutes to provide context on prior coaching.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <cjensen@people-practice.co>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager onboarding & coaching plan for Priya

Thanks — Mon Jul 20 10:00 PT works for me. I can be on the call for the first 30 minutes to cover escalation thresholds.

A couple of asks from leadership:
- Add a 15–20 minute role-play where Priya practices a difficult feedback conversation with a trained facilitator (use volunteer scenario from handoff notes).
- Share the scoring rubric ahead of time so people calibrate asynchronously if they can't attend live.

I'll ask Emma from People Analytics to prep the last two review snapshots (if you want, Stephanie I can loop her in).

—Marcus
Director, Engineering Operations
